name: Cloud Dragon, riding (version B)
note: Version 2. One posed model: the cloud is one unbroken piece, like the drawing: it starts as his dragon afro, runs down behind his left shoulder, across behind his legs, becomes the cloud he stands on, and ends in a curled tail. Claude checked all three views against the drawing (one cloud, same crouch in every view, skin tone, hearts, belt, boots). From behind, the cloud drapes across his back.

name: Pink Puff
note: A static posed model of Pink Puff levitating on all fours: body level, arms reaching down with open clawed hands, knees bent with shins pointing back. The puffs he grabs are left out because the game draws them as particles. Checked every view against the 2D art and each other (same pose, caramel golden-brown skin, no loose pieces). Question for you: the two approved drawings disagree on his top (bare-chested front vs a fluffy pink top on the back drawing); these views follow the bare-chested front.

name: Centaur Bull
note: A static posed model of the Centaur Bull mid-gallop on his own four legs: his right front leg is tucked up and the other three hooves stand on one flat line, so the model has a level base. The glowing stars under his hooves are left out because the game draws them in code. His skin is a little deeper caramel than the 2D art because 3D textures come out lighter. The cheek star, star earring and haunch star sit on his left side, as in the front drawing (the back drawing puts the cheek star on the other side and gives him a cream belly; the model does not copy those). Four legs and the same raised leg checked in every view; the wings stay attached to the hoodie.

name: Rocket-Skate Rider
note: A young skater in a low racing crouch on her own orange-and-magenta rocket skates; the flames are left out because the game draws them in code. Built from the newer concept: oversized orange jacket with a magenta chest stripe, baggy tan cargo pants, bantu knots with orange ties. The concept only shows her from behind, so the front was made up: face looking ahead, a zipped jacket, small gold hoops, a rocket nozzle on each heel, and feet side by side so every view shows the same pose. Checked all three views against the concept and each other.

name: Spirit-Beast Rider
note: Redone at Innocent's request: she now rides the golden spirit cheetah like a jockey, leaning over its shoulders with both hands on a gold collar and her boots tucked against its sides. The cheetah is a glowing gold-to-white spirit with swirling markings, glowing eyes and flame tips on its ears, tail and paws (loose sparks and light trails come from game code). Her look is unchanged. Claude's review: without its spots and the dark tear lines on its face, the beast reads more like a lioness than a cheetah; say if it should get cheetah tear lines and spirit-light spots back.

name: Cloud Rider
note: One posed model: the racer crouched on a solid, comet-shaped cloud board (fat at the front under his sneakers, tapering behind into a curled tail); the long wispy trail in the art is left for code. The art only shows him from behind, so the front is invented: he looks straight ahead, both arms spread evenly, and the board's shape is new. Question for you: he reads close to the Cloud Dragon (bare chest, cloud afro, heart pants, cloud ride). The dark storm afro, blue pants, sneakers and separate board tell them apart up close, but from the chase camera the two may look alike.

name: Wind-Ball Rider
note: One posed model of the girl crouching barefoot on top of her wind ball: a single solid sphere with a teal and white swirl painted on it, her feet touching its top in every view. The loose wind rings in the art are left out because the game draws them in code. The art only shows her from behind, so her face, the front of her cross-wrap top and the knotted sash on her left hip are invented. Known flaw: in the side view her arms sweep slightly backward instead of straight out to the sides (best of three tries).
